supersedes.disposition: retain as exposure-state descriptor; do not interpret as position-building behavior

measurement.Q_definition: absolute BALANCE for explicit PAYOFF_PROFILE=Short and UNIT=NS rows
measurement.eligible_pair: same SERIES_ID and same effective-dated security_id across consecutive publicly disclosed report periods, with explicit short rows in both periods
measurement.corporate_actions: require verified effective-dated split/recapitalization adjustment; otherwise exclude the pair
measurement.zero_or_missing_prior: undefined; no zero imputation and no initiation/covering inference
measurement.interpretation: change in reported share quantity between two report dates; not trade flow and not a trade timestamp

secondary_measurements.delta_short_pct_nav: retain as reported portfolio exposure-state change only
secondary_measurements.prior_mark_and_NAV: only calculate if prior USD fair value, prior shares and fund net assets or validated pctVal-derived NAV are available and sign/unit checks pass

point_in_time.earliest_daily_trade_boundary: first full regular U.S. equity session whose open is strictly after acceptance

economic_test.fixed_direction: larger positive short-share quantity changes predict lower subsequent residual equity returns
economic_test.benchmark: frozen LTM/F80 on identical eligible securities, dates, exposure and costs

decision: Use share-quantity change as the behavioral candidate; retain delta_short_pct_nav only as exposure-state context. No return test until raw filings, amendments, corporate actions and PIT security identity pass.
